root_cause: The GitHub Janitor incident observer used numberOk(), a GitHub PR number validator with < 1,000,000,000 bound, on GITHUB_RUN_ID. Actual post-release run ID 41508842023 fails this bound. The original cleanup step and readback succeeded; the observer failed at RUN_IDENTITY_INVALID before persisting the incident artifact.
prevention_rule: Never reuse validators across GitHub PR, workflow run, job, artifact and commit identity types; fixture must use a real 11-digit Actions run ID and assert PR bounds remain strict. No production green without same-run native observer and artifact readback.

evidence.failed_step: Agent observation and incident writeback on the same original Janitor

fix: Separate runIdOk from bounded PR numberOk; use validated native run ID consistently in observe() and classifyCurrentJanitor(); preserve all branch, incident, Required and CodeQL gates.
terminal_rule: Exact HEAD Required/CodeQL, protected main merge, next existing Janitor native run including agent step and evidence artifact readback, occurrence registry proof only for actual failures, no second scheduler.
